scope: The 3,463 effective source-unlisted catalogue rows from the prior release. Rows include product-list duplicates; these are not 3,463 unique physical cards.
policy: An upstream blank is not evidence of no rarity.
A missing printed symbol is not evidence of no publisher classification.
No blanket Common default or cross-edition grade inheritance.
Publisher product categories that are not rarity remain separate from rarity.
Crobat supplemental photo is a different printing; no grade applied.
limitations: English manufacturer database requires an Imperva security check in this environment. No additional DB paths or regions requested after the block. Two exact cached official literals were retained; other Dragon Vault grades were not extrapolated.
Many Japanese images are low resolution and lack individual official-edition links. Product-wide official lists do not prove an individual grade.
Common reference labels conflict for KSS. Front placeholders and language-mismatched scans cannot certify a physical grade.

limits: Group-level manufacturer API coverage is not an individual source-row-to-official-cardID match.
The official API card-list fields omit rarity; absence from18 filter memberships does not establish no rarity.
Native320px footers can fail to resolve the precise printed glyph.
Separate retailer photos can show a star but cannot determine the existing source row's exact edition/printing.
Nine original image URLs returned404; no absent-grade inference was made.
Generic holder/representative-front photos are marked and do not certify the photographed specimen.
Only2 rows have exact official ID, full number/name linkage and full-resolution official-image inspection.
Remaining rows retain explicit incomplete review status.
